title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 06, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C2.5 (Peaked November 06, 2026 at 15:58 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M3.5 (Peaked November 05, 2026 at 18:33 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 367 km/s (Moderate)
🧲 Bz: +9.2 nT (Northward)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Some C-Class activity! 🔥🌌

Several bright active regions and a broad dark coronal structure are visible across today’s Sun.

Images: NASA SDO/AIA — 193, 335, 171, 304, 131, 94 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
